neighbours.label: Short tokens spelled consonant + '-ate' (gate, mate, crate, plate, hate, skate, fate, Kate; also late, rate, the 'ate' piece of grate, 'gate' in Watergate); a spelling detector, not the sound: eight, wait, great, weight, bait, straight stay silent, and long -ate words (debate, donate, create) or date/state are weak
neighbours.short: short '-ate' tokens by spelling (gate, mate, plate), not the sound
fire: He swung open the old iron gate.
My mate bought the first round of drinks.
She stacked the apples in a wooden crate.
He dropped the dinner plate on the tiles.
We went to skate at the rink.
It was fate that brought them together.
quiet: He swung the old iron weight.
My great uncle bought the first round of drinks.
She stacked the apples in a straight line.
He dropped the fishing bait on the tiles.
I really can't wait for Mondays.
We went straight to the rink.
It was a great day that brought them together.
Eight people called me last night.
neighbours.notes: Near misses swap the -ate token for a word with the same 'ate' sound but another spelling (weight, great, straight, bait, wait, eight), so the test separates spelling from sound. Strongest feeder of the 'late' neuron L4/N11028- (zero-ablation drop 0.11). Played live on stream; chat was quiet, so the sentences are the agent's own.

predictions: 8/8 fire (plate near 0.29 is the weakest), 0 near misses above 0.30; 'great' may reach about 0.10
